en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a European city street scene, likely from the early 20th century. A cobblestone intersection with tram tracks runs through the center, where a streetcar, early automobiles, horse-drawn carts, bicycles, and pedestrians share the road. On the right side are several multi‑story historic buildings with ornate facades, bay windows, gables, and shopfronts with awnings at street level. On the left, large townhouses and trees line the street, leading toward a tall neo‑Gothic church with a slender spire dominating the background. Overhead wires for the tram are visible, and people in period clothing walk or stand along the pavements.
